h1 "🎭 Playwright" [ref=1234]
a ~"Permalink: 🎭 Playwright" [ref=1235]
p "Playwright is a framework for web automation and testing. It drives Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with a single API — in your tests, in your scripts, and as a tool for AI agents." [ref=1247]
h2 "Get Started" [ref=1249]
a ~"Permalink: Get Started" [ref=1250]
p "Choose the path that fits your workflow:" [ref=1251]
th "Best for" [ref=1256]
th "Install" [ref=1257]
a "Playwright Test" [ref=1262]
td "End-to-end testing" [ref=1263]
td > code "npm init playwright@latest" [ref=1265]
a "Playwright CLI" [ref=1269]
td "Coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot)" [ref=1270]
td > code "npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest" [ref=1272]
a "Playwright MCP" [ref=1276]
td "AI agents and LLM-driven automation" [ref=1277]
td > code "npx @playwright/mcp@latest" [ref=1279]
a "Playwright Library" [ref=1283]

h2 "Playwright Test" [ref=1295]
a ~"Permalink: Playwright Test" [ref=1296]
p "Playwright Test is a full-featured test runner built for end-to-end testing. It runs tests across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with full browser isolation, auto-waiting, and web-first assertions." [ref=1297]
h3 "Install" [ref=1299]
a ~"Permalink: Install" [ref=1300]
pre "npm init playwright@latest" [ref=1302]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1304]
p "Or add manually:" [ref=1305]
pre "npm i -D @playwright/test npx playwright install" [ref=1307]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1309]
h3 "Write a test" [ref=1311]
a ~"Permalink: Write a test" [ref=1312]
"page page : :" [ref=1314]
"import{test,expect}from'@playwright/test';test('has title',async({})=>{awaitpage.goto('https://playwright.dev/');awaitexpect(page).toHaveTitle(" [ref=1315]
span "/Playwright/" [ref=1317]
");});test('get started link',async({})=>{awaitpage.goto('https://playwright.dev/');awaitpage.getByRole('link',{name'Get started'}).click();awaitexpect(page.getByRole('heading',{name'Installation'})).toBeVisible();});" [ref=1318]

"npx playwright" [ref=1325]
pre "test" [ref=1326]

p "Tests run in parallel across all configured browsers, in headless mode by default. Each test gets a fresh browser context — full isolation with near-zero overhead." [ref=1329]
h3 "Key capabilities" [ref=1331]
a ~"Permalink: Key capabilities" [ref=1332]
"No artificial timeouts. Playwright waits for elements to be actionable, and assertions automatically retry until conditions are met." [ref=1333]
p > strong "Auto-wait and web-first assertions." [ref=1334]
"Find elements with resilient locators that mirror how users see the page:" [ref=1335]
p > strong "Locators." [ref=1336]
"Each test runs in its own browser context — equivalent to a fresh browser profile. Save authentication state once and reuse it across tests:" [ref=1342]
p > strong "Test isolation." [ref=1343]
": :" [ref=1345]
pre "// Save state after loginawaitpage.context().storageState({path'auth.json'});// Reuse in other teststest.use({storageState'auth.json'});" [ref=1346]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1348]
"Capture execution traces, screenshots, and videos on failure. Inspect every action, DOM snapshot, network request, and console message in the :" [ref=1349]
strong "Tracing." [ref=1350]
a "Trace Viewer" [ref=1351]
": :" [ref=1353]
pre "// playwright.config.tsexportdefaultdefineConfig({use{trace'on-first-retry',},});" [ref=1354]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1356]
pre "npx playwright show-trace trace.zip" [ref=1358]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1360]
"Tests run in parallel by default across all configured browsers." [ref=1361]
p > strong "Parallelism." [ref=1362]
a "Full testing documentation" [ref=1364]
h2 "Playwright CLI" [ref=1366]
a ~"Permalink: Playwright CLI" [ref=1367]
"is a command-line interface for browser automation designed for coding agents. It's more token-efficient than MCP — commands avoid loading large tool schemas and accessibility trees into the model context." [ref=1368]
a "Playwright CLI" [ref=1369]
h3 "Install" [ref=1371]
a ~"Permalink: Install" [ref=1372]
pre "npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest" [ref=1374]

p "Optionally install skills for richer agent integration:" [ref=1377]
pre "playwright-cli install --skills" [ref=1379]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1381]

clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1390]
p "Or run commands directly:" [ref=1391]
"playwright-cli open https://demo.playwright.dev/todomvc/ --headed playwright-cli playwright-cli press Enter playwright-cli screenshot" [ref=1393]
pre "typeBuy groceries" [ref=1394]

h2 "Playwright MCP" [ref=1410]
a ~"Permalink: Playwright MCP" [ref=1411]

h3 "How it works" [ref=1435]
a ~"Permalink: How it works" [ref=1436]
p "Ask your AI assistant to interact with any web page:" [ref=1437]
pre > code "Navigate to https://demo.playwright.dev/todomvc and add a few todo items." [ref=1440]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1442]
p "The agent sees the page as a structured accessibility tree:" [ref=1443]
pre > code "- heading "todos" [level=1] - textbox "What needs to be done?" [ref=e5] - listitem: - checkbox "Toggle Todo" [ref=e10] - text: "Buy groceries"" [ref=1446]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1448]
"It uses element refs like and to click, type, and interact — deterministically and without visual ambiguity. Tools cover navigation, form filling, screenshots, network mocking, storage management, and more." [ref=1449]
code "e5" [ref=1450]
code "e10" [ref=1451]
h2 "Playwright Library" [ref=1456]
a ~"Permalink: Playwright Library" [ref=1457]
"Use as a library for browser automation scripts — web scraping, PDF generation, screenshot capture, and any workflow that needs programmatic browser control without a test runner." [ref=1458]
p > code "playwright" [ref=1459]

h3 "Examples" [ref=1468]
a ~"Permalink: Examples" [ref=1469]
p > strong "Take a screenshot:" [ref=1471]
p > strong "Generate a PDF:" [ref=1478]
": :" [ref=1480]
pre "import{chromium}from'playwright';constbrowser=awaitchromium.launch();constpage=awaitbrowser.newPage();awaitpage.goto('https://playwright.dev/');awaitpage.pdf({path'page.pdf',format'A4'});awaitbrowser.close();" [ref=1481]
clipboard-copy ~"Copy code to clipboard" [ref=1483]
p > strong "Emulate a mobile device:" [ref=1485]
p > strong "Intercept network requests:" [ref=1492]
pre "import{chromium}from'playwright';constbrowser=awaitchromium.launch();constpage=awaitbrowser.newPage();awaitpage.route('**/*.{png,jpg,jpeg}',route=>route.abort());awaitpage.goto('https://playwright.dev/');awaitbrowser.close();" [ref=1495]

h2 "VS Code Extension" [ref=1502]
a ~"Permalink: VS Code Extension" [ref=1503]
"The brings test running, debugging, and code generation directly into your editor." [ref=1504]
a "Playwright VS Code extension" [ref=1505]
"from the editor with a single click. Set breakpoints, inspect variables, and step through test execution with a live browser view." [ref=1506]
p > strong "Run and debug tests" [ref=1507]
"Click "Record new" to open a browser — navigate and interact with your app while Playwright writes the test code for you." [ref=1508]
p > strong "Generate tests with CodeGen." [ref=1509]
